scientific_integrity: The proof uses the original source-initialized inexact sparse Kaczmarz update, exact-rational nine-path enumeration, a strict all-real-exponents bound, and a symbolic two-row projection identity. The polynomial identity, rather than finite checks, proves its universal quantified statement.
scientific_limitations: The strict reversal compares exactly two steps for a full-rank three-row system and all real \(p\ge24\) against the uniform \(p=0\) baseline. It does not establish a worse asymptotic rate or contradict the published Bregman bounds. The two-row obstruction concerns \(\lambda=0\) only; the positive-regularization example uses \(\lambda=1/2\). Priority against unindexed literature remains uncertain.
title: Two-step greed reversal in weighted sparse Kaczmarz and a two-row projection barrier
